all t: Test | misleading[t] implies (some Finding)

all u: Unit | (not used[u] and u not in Conflict) implies (some Orphaning)

all r: Run | (some p: Plugin | r->p in Return.code2) implies (r in Exits2)
all r: Run | ((some p: Plugin | r->p in Return.code1) and (no p: Plugin | r->p in Return.code2)) implies (r in Exits1)
some d: Document, rf: Refused, r: Run | (d->rf in Head.rel) and (d in Unreadable) and (r in Exits2)

all s: Search | (s in First) implies (s not in Trial)

all d1, d2: Document, u: Unit | ((d1 in Checked) and (d2->d1 in Context.rel) and (d2->u in Hold.units) and (u in BareFormula)) implies (u in Held)
no t: Term, w: Word | t->w in Expose.rel
all d: Document | (d not in Worded) implies (no u: Unit, w: Word | d->u in Hold.units and u->w in Expose.rel)
